workflows.name: Financial Document Extraction & Benchmarking Pipeline
workflows.description: End-to-end pipeline to preprocess, chunk, allocate budgets, extract structured data, and benchmark against gold standards with automated regression tracking.

steps.title: Document Chunking & Context Allocation
steps.goal: Chunk financial records into semantic sections and allocate token budget while maintaining 100% factual retention.
steps.notes: Ensures document fits LLM context window without truncating key financial tables.

steps.title: Extraction Prompt Execution
steps.goal: Apply zero-shot financial extraction prompts with strict schema validation.
steps.notes: Applies dual-track extraction with confidence flags for mathematical discrepancies.

steps.title: Annotation QA & Ground Truth Validation
steps.goal: Measure inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's Kappa) and validate gold labels.
steps.notes: Guarantees high-fidelity ground truth for scoring.

steps.title: Evaluation Harness & Regression Tracking
steps.goal: Score model predictions against gold labels and detect any regression against baseline metrics.
steps.notes: Generates complete precision/recall/F1 breakdowns and cost/latency telemetry.
